title.family: Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif

body.family: Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif

label.family: Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif

world.camera: automatic orthographic; selected opponent table flight and directed explosion shot
world.geometryCountsBelow: default 4-division map; other sizes use shared board-layout.ts
world.triangleSilhouette: equilateral, fixed base; interior offsets under 0.1 units
world.lighting: strong cool spotlight during own mine placement; faint stage and side spotlights during exploration, cart light and luminous movement arrows

semantics.text: white for primary and highlighted text; muted gray for supporting and disabled text; dark text on bright buttons; danger color reserved for warnings
semantics.turnAndPrimary: bright ice steel asset + spotlight cue
semantics.availableDestination: pulsing luminous direction arrow + landing ring
semantics.placementMine: upward torn rail + red ember particles; placement owner only
semantics.explosion: temporary torn rail, sparks, shock wave and camera push-in
semantics.neutralRail: same rail appearance regardless of hidden mine status
semantics.disabled: low-contrast inactive asset with muted readable text
